mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product (product_code, category_code, product_name, manufacturer_id, description, price, stock, status) VALUES (#{productCode}, #{categoryCode}, #{productName}, #{manufacturerId}, #{description}, #{price}, #{stock}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE product SET product_code = #{productCode}, category_code = #{categoryCode}, product_name = #{productName}, manufacturer_id = #{manufacturerId}, description = #{description}, price = #{price}, stock = #{stock}, status = #{status} WHERE product_id = #{productId}
UPDATE product SET status = #{status} WHERE product_id = #{productId}
UPDATE product SET stock = #{stock} WHERE product_id = #{productId}
